transcript:
Speaker A: आज मैं तुम्हें एक कहानी सुनाता हूँ। मुंबई का सबसे खौफनाक डॉन, एक ऐसा कातिल जिसका ठिकाना 15 साल से कोई नहीं जानता। जो उसके रास्ते आता, वो उसके हाथों मरता। और उसे खत्म करने के लिए भेजा गया एक इंग्लिश टीचर। लेकिन ये टीचर असली में टीचर था ही नहीं। [Today I will tell you a story. Mumbai's most terrifying don, a killer whose whereabouts no one has known for 15 years. Whoever comes in his way, dies by his hands. And sent to eliminate him is an English teacher. But this teacher wasn't actually a teacher.]
Speaker B: आधी रात को एक लुटेरा आया। तू अभी किडनैप हो चुका है। [A robber came at midnight. You have been kidnapped now.]
Speaker C: किडनैप? [Kidnapped?]
Speaker B: ये गोली सीधा तेरे भेजे में घुसेगी। [This bullet will go straight into your brain.]
Speaker D: जलाल को खत्म करना इतना आसान नहीं है, शेखर। तुमसे पहले भी एक एजेंट आया था यहाँ। कुछ नहीं बिगाड़ पाया जलाल का। उल्टा जलाल ने ही उस एजेंट को कहीं पे बंद कर दिया। 15 साल से वो एजेंट गायब है। शेखर, सुनो। तुम अभी अपना फोकस सिर्फ आयशा पे रखो। उसी के ज़रिए तुम जलाल तक पहुँच पाओगे। उसके अलावा कोई रास्ता नहीं है। जलाल कब कहाँ होता है, कब किस रूप में होता है, ये... ये कोई नहीं जानता। [Eliminating Jalal is not that easy, Shekhar. An agent came here before you too. He couldn't do anything to Jalal. Instead, Jalal locked that agent up somewhere. That agent has been missing for 15 years. Shekhar, listen. For now, keep your focus only on Ayesha. Only through her will you be able to reach Jalal. There is no other way. When and where Jalal is, in what form... no one knows.]
Speaker C: वैसे जलाल और वो डॉन सेबेस्टियन के बीच जो ड्रग की डील होने वाली थी, उसकी कोई खबर? [By the way, any news about the drug deal that was supposed to happen between Jalal and Don Sebastian?]
Speaker D: मैंने ट्रैक किया है। वो डील इसी वीक में होगी। डॉन सेबेस्टियन खुद मुंबई आ रहा है। यही मौका है, शेखर। एक तीर से दो शिकार करने होंगे। [I have tracked it. That deal will happen this week. Don Sebastian himself is coming to Mumbai. This is the chance, Shekhar. We have to kill two birds with one stone.]
Speaker B: मालिक। माफ़ कर दीजिए, मालिक। आगे से कभी शिकायत का मौका नहीं दूँगा। [Master. Forgive me, master. I won't give you a chance to complain again.]
Speaker E: माफ़ी। माफ़ी तुम्हें तब मिलेगी जब तुम उस शेखर की हिस्ट्री निकाल के लाओगे। उसके लड़ने का तरीका एक टीचर वाला नहीं था। वो जैसा दिख रहा है, असल में ऐसा है नहीं। [Forgiveness. You will get forgiveness only when you bring Shekhar's history. His way of fighting was not like a teacher's. He is not what he looks like.]
Speaker A: जलाल को शक हो गया। अब शेखर के पास वक्त नहीं है। क्या वो मिशन पूरा कर पाएगा या खुद भी 15 साल कैद हो जाएगा? इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप खोलो और सर्च करके देखो 'जासूस टीचर'। और साथ में वही इंग्लिश सीखो जो शेखर को डॉन के घर में ज़िंदा रखती है। आज ही शुरू करो। [Jalal has got suspicious. Now Shekhar has no time. Will he be able to complete the mission or will he also be imprisoned for 15 years? Open the English Seekho app and search for 'Jasoos Teacher'. And along with it, learn the same English that keeps Shekhar alive in the don't house. Start today.]
Speaker F: तो इंस्टॉल बटन पे क्लिक करो और इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
on_screen_text:
JASOOS TEACHER
English Seekho
Aaj main tumhe ek kahani sunata hoon. [Today I will tell you a story.]
Aadhi raat ko ek lutera aaya. [A robber came at midnight.]
Tu abhi kidnap ho chuka hai. [You have been kidnapped now.]
kidnap?
yeh goli seedha tere bheje mein ghusegi. [this bullet will go straight into your brain.]
Jalal ko khatm karna itna aasan nahin hai, Shekhar. [Eliminating Jalal is not that easy, Shekhar.]
Tumse pehle bhi ek agent aaya tha yahan. [An agent came here before you too.]
Kuchh nahin bigaad paya Jalal ka. [He couldn't do anything to Jalal.]
Ulta Jalal ne hi us agent ko kahin pe band kar diya. [Instead, Jalal locked that agent up somewhere.]
15 saal se woh agent gayab hai. [That agent has been missing for 15 years.]
Shekhar suno. [Shekhar, listen.]
Tum abhi apna focus sirf Ayesha pe rakho. [For now, keep your focus only on Ayesha.]
Usi ke zariye tum Jalal tak pahunch paoge. [Only through her will you be able to reach Jalal.]
Uske alawa koi rasta nahin hai. [There is no other way.]
Jalal kab kahan hota hai, [When and where Jalal is,]
kab kis roop mein hota hai, [in what form he is,]
yeh... yeh koi nahin jaanta [no one knows this...]
Waise Jalal aur woh Don Sebastian ke beech jo drug ki deal hone wali thi, uski koi khabar? [By the way, any news about the drug deal that was supposed to happen between Jalal and Don Sebastian?]
Maine track kiya hai. [I have tracked it.]
Woh deal isi week mein hogi. [That deal will happen this week.]
Don Sebastian khud Mumbai aa raha hai. [Don Sebastian himself is coming to Mumbai.]
Yahi mauka hai, Shekhar. [This is the chance, Shekhar.]
Ek teer se do shikaar karne honge. [We have to kill two birds with one stone.]
Malik. Maaf kar dijiye, malik. [Master. Forgive me, master.]
Aage se kabhi shikayat ka mauka nahin dunga. [I won't give you a chance to complain again.]
Maafi. [Forgiveness.]
Maafi tumhe tab milegi jab tum us Shekhar ki history nikal ke laoge. [You will get forgiveness only when you bring Shekhar's history.]
Uske ladne ka tareeka ek teacher wala nahin tha. [His way of fighting was not like a teacher's.]
woh jaisa dikh raha hai asal mein aisa hai nahin. [He is not what he looks like.]
bura haal karta hoon. [I will make it worse.]
INSTALL NOW
summary: The ad presents a dramatic thriller skit titled 'Jasoos Teacher' about an undercover agent posing as an English teacher to infiltrate a dangerous crime syndicate. It uses this suspenseful narrative to hook viewers and drive them to download the 'English Seekho' app to watch the full series and learn English.
